title: Admin & Setup — User Manual
summary: How Users, Roles & Permissions, Categories & Locations, Email Templates, System Settings, and the Audit Log work.

sections.body:
Overview

Admin & Setup is where system administrators configure the app, across six tabs: Users, Roles & Permissions, Categories & Locations, Email Templates, System Settings, and Audit Log.

What Each Tab Does

  • Users — create accounts (a temporary password is emailed automatically), deactivate or reset users. Each user row (and their profile page) has a QR Code action that generates a scannable code linking straight to their profile.
  • Roles & Permissions — edit the per-module View / Create / Edit / Delete / Export matrix for each role; changes take effect immediately for already-logged-in users.
  • Categories & Locations — manage Asset Categories (including their Form Templates and computer/show-asset flags), physical Locations, and Helpdesk Ticket Categories. Locations and Ticket Categories can both be added, renamed (edit icon), and removed from here.
  • Email Templates — design the emails sent for account creation, asset assignment, overdue tasks, and low stock, using a block-based builder.
  • System Settings — branding (logo/favicon), company name, and password policy.
  • Audit Log — every mutating action taken anywhere in the app, who did it, and when.

Tips

  • Super Admin and Admin roles always have full access to every module — the permission matrix can't lock them out.
  • Locations defined here are the single source of truth app-wide — the same list appears in the location picker on Assets, Stock Items, NVRs/Cameras, and Access Control devices, so renaming a Location here updates it everywhere it's referenced.
